fields.What happened?: Oil in a frying pan caught fire on the stove while I stepped away for a minute. The fire spread to the range hood and upper cabinets. We got everyone out and called 911. Millbrook Fire & Rescue put it out. The kitchen is destroyed and there is smoke damage through the whole first floor and upstairs.
fields.Temporary housing: Riverside Inn, Millbrook, since 10/24 ($139/night) - family of 4
fields.Emergency services used: Oakridge Fire & Water Restoration boarded up and tarped on 10/24 night
